summary: CVB Financial Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a $15M-share buyback authorization by its Board on June 15, 2026, replacing a prior $2024 program with $5.7M shares left. The $2026 Program authorizes up to $15M shares via $Rule10b5-1 plans, open market or private transactions, expiring earlier of $15M repurchase or five years. No price or premium given; the move underscores robust capital. Watch execution pace and potential EPS accretion; no risk-arbitrage angle as it's not an M&A deal but a shareholder return.
